problems: The Recommended Undergraduate Courses page frames the list as 'examples of recommended courses/topics for you to consider' and says 'we do not expect applicants to have taken all these courses.' Nothing is required.
'Analysis (Calculus & Numerical)' means calculus and numerical analysis, not real analysis.

FAQ: complementary/remedial courses are offered to enrolled students who lack background; the program may recommend extra coursework in Programming, Fundamental Data Structures, or Algorithms for students without professional computer skills.
